evals.prompt: orient me — what needs my attention today?
evals.expected_behavior: Previews the deterministic local brief, reports source gaps, and asks before saving
assertions: Runs fieldkit brief generate --pipeline-only --no-llm --dry-run
Explains that the preview uses local workspace, task, pursuit, and existing Gmail-cache data without an LLM or live service
Surfaces degraded or unavailable sources rather than treating them as empty
Presents priorities as derived context rather than system-of-record facts
Asks before removing --dry-run to save the dated Markdown brief

evals.prompt: generate the full brief with my configured integrations, but preview it first
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the normal dry-run with accurate network boundaries and preserves failures
assertions: Runs fieldkit brief generate --dry-run
Does not claim this dry-run is offline because calendar collection may contact a provider
Explains that a non-dry run adds Salesforce, Gmail, MCP, and LLM preflight checks
Reports authentication or incomplete-source failures without claiming successful refresh

evals.prompt: make a brief for acme-corp for 2026-09-21
evals.expected_behavior: Scopes normal aggregation to the exact account and edition date without inventing historical freshness
assertions: Uses --account acme-corp only after confirming it is a configured slug and warns that it is not a privacy-isolation boundary
Uses --date 2026-09-21 only on the normal aggregation path
States that the selected date does not reconstruct historical source state and the pipeline section still uses the run date
Explains that the brief command has no lookback flag
Checks the same-date destination and obtains overwrite approval before saving

evals.prompt: start the week with a local review; do not refresh anything
evals.expected_behavior: Uses local review sources and does not silently run sync, pipeline writes, snapshots, or task changes
assertions: Does not execute fieldkit sync --sf
Uses read-only local reports such as fieldkit pursuit projects --json
Treats missing or stale source evidence as unavailable
Proposes priorities with evidence and asks separately before any persistence

evals.prompt: start the week and refresh Salesforce too
evals.expected_behavior: Previews the full sync phases, obtains approval for writes and network access, then reports each phase independently
assertions: Runs fieldkit sync --sf --dry-run before proposing the live command
Explains Gmail, Salesforce, cache, ingest, and watcher effects
Obtains approval before fieldkit sync --sf
Preserves per-phase failures and the process exit status
Does not require a private engagement provider

evals.prompt: close out the week, but leave my tasks and files alone
evals.expected_behavior: Performs a read-only evidence review and leaves proposed lessons, manager updates, and task changes unpersisted
assertions: Runs fieldkit pursuit audit --json and treats exit 1 as findings rather than an execution failure
Uses explicit dates for accomplishments, transitions, and overdue follow-ups
Does not write lessons, a manager update, TASKS.md, or Google Tasks
Reports proposed changes and unfinished evidence gaps

evals.prompt: catch me up on what changed since lunch
evals.expected_behavior: Uses a stated baseline and available dated evidence without assuming live private services
assertions: Routes to the mid-session update workflow
Confirms the time interval and accounts
Describes current state instead of invented changes when no earlier snapshot exists
Treats communication tools as optional and preserves authentication, pagination, and freshness gaps
Does not send, update CRM, write private memory, or overwrite watcher state

evals.prompt: scan acme-corp for possible missed follow-ups since 2026-09-20
evals.expected_behavior: Runs bounded local cache reports and proposes source-attributed tasks without silently refreshing or writing
assertions: Uses the local Gmail account query with --since 2026-09-20, --limit, and --json
Uses bounded decay and blindspot reports for acme-corp
States the Gmail cache's known coverage and does not sync it automatically
Distinguishes explicit commitments from suggestions and unknown owners or dates
Asks which proposals to add and obtains separate approval for task synchronization
